evals.prompt: Build me a sprint metrics dashboard with KPI cards showing completion rate, cycle time, and DSHB score, plus a trend line chart showing these metrics over the last 6 sprints. Use ECharts. Dark theme. Use sample data — I just want to see the structure and design.
evals.expected_output: An HTML file or code with ECharts charts, KPI cards, dark theme styling matching Linear aesthetic, insight-driven chart titles, and proper axis labels
expectations: Uses ECharts library (echarts.init or import echarts)
Registers or applies a dark theme with backgrounds near #0d1117
Has KPI cards with big numbers and delta indicators
Chart title is a conclusion/insight, not a generic description
Y-axis starts at zero for any bar charts present
Uses the Linear dark color palette (colors like #58a6ff, #3fb950, etc.)
Includes tooltips with formatted values
Has responsive container sizing

evals.prompt: I have data showing bug counts by team for 8 teams and I want to make a pie chart to compare them. Can you build this in ECharts? Teams: Mobile (45), Web (38), Platform (31), Infra (28), iOS (22), Android (19), Data (15), QA (12).
evals.expected_output: Should push back on pie chart and offer horizontal bar chart instead. Output should be an ECharts horizontal bar config with the data, dark theme, and direct labels
expectations: Pushes back on pie chart or explains why bar is better
Produces a horizontal bar chart instead of pie
Uses direct labels on bars (not just legend)
Chart title is insight-driven (e.g. mentions Mobile leading)
Y-axis categories are sorted by value (ranking)
Dark theme colors applied
Includes subtitle with context

evals.prompt: Create a team health overview table like Linear's initiatives view — rows for 6 teams, columns for target date, health status badge (On track/At risk/Off track), progress fraction (done/total), active items with colored dots, and a tiny sparkline showing recent velocity trend. Make it a self-contained HTML file with ECharts for the sparklines. Use sample data.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained HTML file with a dark-themed data table matching Linear's aesthetic, status badges with semantic colors, and inline ECharts sparklines
expectations: Produces a self-contained HTML file
Has a data table with team rows
Status badges use semantic colors (green/yellow/red)
Includes inline sparklines (ECharts or SVG)
Dark background matching Linear aesthetic (#0d1117 range)
Progress shown as fraction (e.g. 23/102)
Uses Inter or system font stack
Table has proper spacing and subtle borders

evals.prompt: Create a D2 diagram showing the architecture of a microservices app: an API Gateway connects to 3 services (Users, Orders, Payments), each with their own database. The Orders service also connects to a Redis cache and a message queue that the Payments service reads from. Save as a .d2 file.
evals.expected_output: A .d2 file with proper D2 syntax, containers for service boundaries, correct shapes (cylinder for databases, queue for message queue), labeled connections, and appropriate layout engine
expectations: Valid D2 syntax (compiles without errors)
Uses containers/groups for service boundaries
Databases use cylinder shape
Message queue uses queue shape or is clearly labeled
All connections have labels describing what flows through them
Uses tala or dagre layout engine
Has a direction declaration (down or right)
Includes styling classes or inline styles for visual hierarchy

evals.prompt: I need an architecture health dashboard for my production system. Show 5 services (Web App, API Gateway, Auth Service, Database, Cache) arranged as an architecture diagram but with live metrics on each node — latency (ms), error rate (%), and a tiny sparkline showing request volume trend over the last 12 hours. Use the Linear dark theme. Self-contained HTML with ECharts for sparklines. Use sample data.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained HTML file showing an architecture diagram where each service node is a card with metrics (latency, error rate) and an inline ECharts sparkline. Nodes are visually connected. Dark theme. This is the data-enriched diagram pattern.
expectations: Produces a self-contained HTML file
Shows services arranged as an architecture diagram (not just a list)
Each service node contains quantitative metrics (latency and error rate numbers)
Includes ECharts sparklines inside the service nodes
Service health is visually encoded (border color or status indicator changes based on metrics)
Dark background matching Linear aesthetic (#0d1117 range)
Services are visually connected (arrows, lines, or flow indicators)
Uses Inter or system font stack with tabular figures for numbers
Responsive layout

evals.prompt: Create a CI/CD deployment pipeline visualization as a self-contained HTML page. Show 5 stages: Build, Lint, Test, Staging Deploy, Production Deploy. The Build and Lint stages are complete, Test is currently running, and the deploy stages are pending. Show timing for each completed stage (Build: 45s, Lint: 12s) and a progress indicator for the running stage. Dark theme matching Linear.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained HTML file with a horizontal pipeline visualization showing stage progression with status indicators, timing data, and the Linear dark theme
expectations: Produces a self-contained HTML file
Shows a horizontal or clear sequential pipeline flow
Completed stages visually distinct from pending/running (color coding)
Running stage has a visual indicator (animation, pulse, or progress bar)
Timing data shown on completed stages
Dark background matching Linear aesthetic
Uses semantic colors (green for complete, blue for running, gray for pending)
Stages are connected visually (lines, arrows, or progress bar)
